description: We are Team TerraShield AI from Morocco! Our project is an Intelligent Earth Environmental Monitoring & Early Warning System. We use NASA satellite data and AI to detect floods, fires, and droughts before they happen and send early warnings to protect people and farms.What I want from you is not to be an expert, but to be serious and passionate about learning and working hard. Together we will be the best team. I trust you all. Let's build it!
summary:
Implemented the AI and Machine Learning components of EarthTrend AI, focusing on environmental time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and AI-powered explanations.

Key contributions:

Developed environmental forecasting using Prophet, including prediction intervals.

Implemented backtesting using historical data from the last 36 months and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) evaluation.

Built anomaly detection using STL decomposition and Isolation Forest.

Integrated the Groq API to generate natural-language explanations based on computed scientific results.

Added an optional question-answering feature that responds using the available environmental data.

Developed FastAPI endpoints to expose the AI/ML functionalities to the application.

Added tests for forecasting and anomaly detection.

The implementation aims to make environmental trends easier to understand while keeping AI-generated explanations grounded in computed results and acknowledging scientific uncertainty
